reason: Adds an image-input declaration checkbox to DSH's model catalog UI and optionally provides a configurable external vision relay for endpoints that lack native image support.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 模型目录添加“图片输入”声明勾选框，并可选通过用户配置的兼容端点提供视觉中继。
summaries.en: Adds an image-input declaration checkbox to the DSH model catalog and optionally provides a vision relay through a user-configured compatible endpoint.

capabilities: Patches the DSH model settings UI at startup to add an image-input checkbox
Persists the selected model input modality through DSH settings
Optionally sends image data to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Provides status, connectivity-test, and runtime-configuration tools for the optional vision relay
